title: The card detail view loads when first opened
notes: The card detail dialog no longer rides the entry chunk: the cards barrels no longer re-export CardDetail, the landing prefetches the dialog's chunk on pointer, touch or focus intent on a fan card, and the account screen rides its own route chunk while the gate's sign-out helpers stay entry-static. How cards look only: no card plays differently.

player.title: The card detail view loads when first opened
fixes: The home page no longer downloads the card detail view before it can start, so the first screen is ready sooner on slow connections.
